title: Ribogreen Assay - 1 Standard and up to 24 Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Arrange samples in tuberack
steps.instruction: Place the standard and up to 24 samples in the tuberack located in slot 1 following this layout: A1 → sample 1, B1 → sample 2, C1 → sample 3, D1 → sample 4, A2 → sample 5, B2 → sample 6, C2 → sample 7, D2 → sample 8, and continue similarly for remaining wells.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your desired protocol parameters (volumes, incubation times, etc.) in the software interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip the archive if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files (JSON extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the robot deck to match the deck map specified in the protocol (e.g., place the tuberack in slot 1, tip rack, etc.).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate the pipette, tip rack, and all labware positions; consult support articles for guidance if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the Opentrons App to start the Ribogreen assay.
